newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt pound overnight rates narrow, one week up.
newsitem.headline: Egypt pound overnight rates narrow, one week up.

text.p: Egyptian pound overnight interbank rates narrowed on Monday in a private sector market which was short before easing a bit by midday, bankers said.
One banker said overnight rates ranged from between 10-1/2 to 11 percent against 10-3/16 and 11-1/4 percent on Sunday.
One week rates were 10-5/8 and 11-1/8, bankers said.
"The market started very short but then became relieved a little bit," one banker said.
"This might be because of the repo," he added.
The Central Bank announced a 700 million pound ($206 million) repo which would be valid for four days from Sunday.
Public sector banks maintained their minimum overnight lending rates at 10-1/2 percent.
